items.title: 5.4 Enzyme ke kaam ki raftar par asar dalne wale awamil (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.4, printed pages 131-133.

blocks.text: Enzymes jis mahol (environment) mein kaam karte hain us ke liye bohat hassas (sensitive) hote hain. Har woh tabdeeli jo enzyme ki chemistry ya us ki teen-dimensional shakal badal de, us ki sargarmi (activity) par asar dalti hai. Enzyme ke kaam ki raftar par asar dalne wale kuch awamil (factors) aage bayan kiye ja rahe hain.

Protein ki shakal un hydrogen bonds aur hydrophobic interactions (pani se door rehne wale hisson ki kashish) se tay hoti hai jo us ki polypeptide chains ko ek khaas jagah thame rakhte hain. Temperature ki thori si tabdeeli bhi in bonds ko asaani se tor deti hai. Har enzyme ek khaas temperature par sab se tez kaam karta hai; ise us ka optimum temperature (behtareen darja-hararat) kehte hain. Insani enzymes ka optimum temperature 37 °C hai.

blocks.alt: Reaction ki raftar (rate of reaction) aur 10 se 70 degree Celsius tak darja-hararat ka graph. Curve pehle aahista, phir tezi se barh kar taqreeban 37 degree par choti tak jata hai (nuqtedar lakeer), phir tezi se gir kar taqreeban 60 degree par sifar ho jata hai. Teer barhte hisse (Enzyme gains kinetic energy), choti (Optimum temperature) aur girte hisse (Enzyme being denatured) ki taraf hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.5: Darja-hararat (temperature) ka enzyme ki sargarmi par asar (kitab ki Figure 5.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen (left) taraf garmi barhne se molecules tez harkat karte aur zyada takrate hain, is liye raftar barhti hai. Choti optimum temperature hai (insani enzymes ke liye 37 degree Celsius). Is ke baad garmi enzyme ke bonds tor deti hai, us ki shakal bigar jati hai (denaturation) aur raftar tezi se gir kar taqreeban 60 degree par khatam ho jati hai.

Jab temperature optimum se neeche girta hai to enzyme ki shakal banane wale bonds kam lachakdar (less flexible) ho jate hain. Woh active site mein woh tabdeeli (induced change) nahin aane dete jo enzyme ke kaam ke liye zaroori hai, is liye reaction sust ho jata hai. Jab temperature ek had tak barhaya jaye to garmi activation energy mein madad deti hai aur reactions tez ho jate hain. Garmi substrate aur enzyme molecules ko kinetic energy (harkat ki tawanai) bhi deti hai; woh tezi se harkat karte hain, zyada baar takrate hain aur reaction ki raftar barh jati hai. Lekin jab temperature optimum se kaafi upar chala jaye to garmi enzyme molecules ke atoms ki thartharahat (vibrations) barha deti hai. Jab yeh thartharahat bohat shadeed ho jaye to bonds polypeptide chains ko sahi jagah nahin thaam pate aur enzyme ki globular shakal khatam ho jati hai. Is ko enzyme ka denaturation (shakal bigar jana) kehte hain. Is se enzyme ke kaam ki raftar tezi se girti hai aur kaam bilkul ruk bhi sakta hai.

blocks.title: Thermophilic bacteria
blocks.text: Thermophilic (garmi pasand) bacteria garam chashmon (hot springs) mein rehte hain. Un ke proteins ki polypeptide arms ke darmiyan bonding zyada mazboot hoti hai, is liye woh 70 °C ya is se zyada temperature par bhi kaam kar sakte hain.

Tamam enzymes pH ki ek tang had (narrow range) mein sab se tez kaam karte hain. Is pH mein thori si tabdeeli (kami ya izafa) bhi enzyme ka kaam sust kar deti hai ya bilkul rok deti hai. Har enzyme ek khaas pH par sab se acha kaam karta hai, jise us ka optimum pH kehte hain. Maslan pepsin tezabi (acidic, kam pH) mahol mein kaam karta hai, jabke trypsin alkaline (zyada pH) mahol mein sab se acha kaam karta hai. Kuch enzymes, jaise kachay papite ka papain, tezabi aur alkaline dono mahol mein kaam karte hain.

Enzyme ki globular banawat mein polypeptide chains mukhalif charge wale amino acids ke darmiyan bonds se jure hote hain, maslan glutamic acid (−) aur lysine (+). Yeh bonds hydrogen ion concentration (H⁺ ki miqdar) ke liye hassas hain. pH badalne se active site ke amino acids ka ionization (charge lena) badal sakta hai, aur substrate ka ionization bhi badal sakta hai. pH mein shadeed tabdeeli enzyme ke bonds tor deti hai aur enzyme denature ho jata hai.

blocks.caption: Aham insani enzymes ka optimum pH (kitab ka table)

blocks.alt: Reaction ki raftar aur pH (1 se 10) ka graph jis mein ghante (bell) jaise teen curves hain, har ek ki choti par nuqtedar lakeer: Pepsin ki choti taqreeban pH 1.6 par, Salivary amylase ki taqreeban pH 4.6 par, aur Pancreatic lipase ki, jo neecha curve hai, taqreeban pH 8 par.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.6: Kuch enzymes ka optimum pH aur pH badalne ka enzyme ki sargarmi par asar (kitab ki Figure 5.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har enzyme ki apni choti hai, yani apna optimum pH: pepsin (maide mein) tezabi (acidic), salivary amylase (munh mein) halka tezabi, pancreatic lipase (chhoti aant mein) alkaline. Choti se kisi taraf bhi pH badle to raftar girti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki chhapi hui Figure 5.6 mein pepsin ki choti pH 2 aur pancreatic lipase ki choti pH 9 par hai, jabke kitab ka apna table pepsin 1.5 se 1.6 aur pancreatic lipase 8.0 batata hai. Yahan chotiyan table ke mutabiq (1.6 aur 8) banai gayi hain.

Enzymes bohat kaar-aamad (efficient) hain; enzyme ke thore se molecules bhi substrate ki bari miqdar ke reactions chala sakte hain. Agar substrate bohat zyada ho to enzyme wale reaction ki kul raftar seedhi us waqt maujood enzyme ki miqdar par munhasir hoti hai. Jab enzyme ki concentration barhti hai to zyada enzyme molecules aur zyada active sites hoti hain, is liye zyada substrate molecules nayi active sites se jur kar products bante hain. Lekin agar enzyme barhta jaye aur substrate utna hi rahe to mazeed substrate molecules jurne ke liye nahin bachte; is liye raftar ek jaisi (constant) reh jati hai aur aage nahin barhti (Fig. 5.7).

blocks.alt: Reaction ki raftar aur enzyme ki concentration ka graph. Lakeer origin se seedhi barhti hai, phir mur kar ek nuqtedar satah ke saath seedhi (flat) chalti hai; mor par teer ke saath likha hai No more substrate to attach with enzyme.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.7: Enzyme ki concentration ka enzyme ki sargarmi par asar (kitab ki Figure 5.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jab tak substrate wafir hai, zyada enzyme ka matlab zyada active sites aur zyada raftar, is liye lakeer seedhi barhti hai. Mor ke baad tamam substrate pehle hi enzymes se jura hua hai; mazeed enzyme ke liye substrate nahin bacha, is liye raftar barabar (constant) rehti hai.

Agar enzyme molecules ki active sites khali hon to substrate ki concentration barhane se reaction ki raftar barhti hai. Agar enzyme ki miqdar ek jaisi rakhi jaye aur substrate barhaya jaye to ek aisa nuqta aata hai jis ke baad substrate barhane se raftar mazeed nahin barhti.

Jab enzyme molecules khali hon (substrate kam ho) to naye substrate molecules khali active sites se jurte hain aur diye gaye waqt mein zyada products bante hain, yani raftar barhti hai. Lekin jab tamam active sites bhar jayen (substrate zyada ho) to mazeed substrate molecules ko khali jagah nahin milti, is liye raftar nahin barhti (Fig. 5.8).

blocks.alt: Reaction ki raftar aur substrate ki concentration ka graph. Lakeer origin se seedhi barhti hai, phir mur kar nuqtedar satah ke saath seedhi chalti hai; mor par teer ke saath likha hai No more active sites for substrate.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.8: Substrate ki concentration ka enzyme ki sargarmi par asar (kitab ki Figure 5.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Enzyme ki miqdar yahan mustaqil hai. Shuru mein khali active sites hain, to zyada substrate se raftar barhti hai. Mor par tamam active sites bhar chuki hain (saturation); ab mazeed substrate ko khali site nahin milti, is liye raftar aage nahin barhti.

blocks.prompt: Bonds ki madad se samjhayen ke thanda karna enzyme ko sust kyun karta hai jabke optimum se kahin zyada garam karna use bilkul rok deta hai, aur thermophilic bacteria 70 degree Celsius par kaise zinda rehte hain.
blocks.explanation: Thanda karna hydrogen bonds aur hydrophobic taalluqat ko sakht kar deta hai, to active site induced tabdeeli nahin kar pata, aur raftar girti hai magar enzyme salamat rehta hai. Shadeed garmi atoms ko itni shiddat se tharthrati hai ke yeh bonds zanjeeron ko apni jagah nahin rakh pate; globular shakal khatam ho jati hai (denaturation) aur sargarmi ruk jati hai. Thermophilic bacteria ke proteins ki polypeptide bazuon ke darmiyan bonding zyada mazboot hai, is liye un ke enzymes 70 degree ya zyada par apni shakal rakhte hain.

items: Temperature: insani enzymes ka optimum 37 °C; is se neeche bonds sakht aur raftar kam; is se bohat upar denaturation se globular shakal khatam. Thermophilic bacteria 70 °C ya zyada par kaam karte hain.

pH: har enzyme ka apna tang optimum pH (pepsin 1.5–1.6, trypsin 7.8–8.7; papain dono mahol mein); pH badalne se active site aur substrate ka ionization badalta hai, aur shadeed pH enzyme ko denature karta hai.

Enzyme ki concentration: substrate wafir ho to raftar enzyme ke saath barhti hai, phir ek jaisi ho jati hai. Substrate ki concentration: khali active sites tak raftar barhti hai, sab bhar jayen to barhna band.
